-- Spec: append a copy of s to the borrowed list dst, editing it in place.

-- Length of xs after s is appended. Declared so add_name's effect can be stated and checked.
added_len(xs: List[str], s: str) -> int =
  post out == xs.len() + 1
  ex added_len(["a"], "b") == 2
  xs.len() + 1

-- Appends a deep copy of s to dst. Returns nothing; the caller's list is changed.
add_name(var dst: List[str], s: str) =
  pre dst.len() >= 0
  post dst.len() == added_len(dst, s) - 1 + 1
  dst.append(copy s)
